events.title: 칼사다 데 칼라트라바에서 태어나다
events.description: 스페인 시우다드레알주 칼사다 데 칼라트라바의 소박한 집안에서 태어났다.
events.description_en: He was born into a modest family in Calzada de Calatrava, in the province of Ciudad Real, Spain.
events.place_name_en: Calzada de Calatrava, Ciudad Real, Spain

events.title: 수도원 학교에 보내지다
events.title_en: He was sent to a religious boarding school
events.description: 가족이 에스트레마두라로 옮기면서 사제가 되길 바란 부모 뜻에 따라 수도원 학교에 들어갔다. 엄격한 생활에 적응하지 못했고, 몰래 다닌 영화관이 그의 숨구멍이 됐다.
events.description_en: When his family moved to Extremadura, his parents, hoping he would become a priest, sent him to a religious boarding school. He never fit into its strict routine, and the cinema he snuck off to became his escape.

events.title: 영화를 좇아 마드리드로 올라가다
events.title_en: He moved to Madrid to chase film
events.description: 영화 학교가 문을 닫은 시절이었지만 홀로 마드리드로 올라갔다. 벼룩시장에서 물건을 팔며 생계를 꾸렸다.
events.description_en: Though the film school in Madrid was closed at the time, he moved there alone. He supported himself by selling odds and ends at a flea market.

events.title: 텔레포니카에 다니며 슈퍼8 단편을 찍다
events.title_en: He worked at Telefónica while shooting Super-8 shorts
events.description: 통신회사 텔레포니카에서 십여 년을 사무직으로 일하면서 퇴근 후 슈퍼8 카메라로 단편을 찍었다. 파비오 매크나마라와 함께 펑크 듀오 알모도바르 이 매크나마라로 클럽 무대에도 섰다.
events.description_en: He spent over a decade as an office worker at the telephone company Telefónica, shooting Super-8 shorts after hours. He also performed in clubs with the punk duo Almodóvar y McNamara, alongside Fabio McNamara.

events.title: 장편 데뷔작으로 라 모비다를 대표하다
events.title_en: His feature debut became a symbol of La Movida
events.description: 장편 데뷔작 『페피, 루시, 봄, 그리고 다른 보통 여자들』을 내놓았다. 프랑코 사후 마드리드를 휩쓴 자유의 물결, 라 모비다를 대표하는 작품이 됐다.
events.description_en: He released his feature debut, Pepi, Luci, Bom and Other Girls Like Mom. It became a defining work of La Movida, the wave of freedom that swept Madrid after Franco's death.

events.title: 동생과 엘 데세오를 세우다
events.title_en: He founded El Deseo with his brother
events.description: 동생 아구스틴 알모도바르와 함께 제작사 엘 데세오를 세웠다. 이후 자신의 영화 대부분을 이 회사를 통해 만들었다.
events.description_en: He founded the production company El Deseo with his brother Agustín Almodóvar. From then on he made most of his films through it.

events.title: 『신경쇠약 직전의 여자』로 세계에 알려지다
events.title_en: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown brought him world attention
events.description: 『신경쇠약 직전의 여자』가 베니스 영화제 각본상을 받고 아카데미 외국어영화상 후보에 올랐다. 이 작품으로 국제적 명성을 얻었다.
events.description_en: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown won the screenplay award at Venice and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film. The film brought him international recognition.

events.title: 『내 어머니의 모든 것』으로 오스카를 받다
events.title_en: All About My Mother won him an Oscar
events.description: 『내 어머니의 모든 것』이 아카데미 외국어영화상을 받았다.
events.description_en: All About My Mother won the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film.

events.title: 『그녀에게』로 각본상을 받다
events.title_en: Talk to Her won him the screenplay Oscar
events.description_en: Talk to Her won him the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay.

events.title: 첫 영어 장편으로 황금사자상을 받다
events.title_en: His first English-language feature won the Golden Lion
events.description: 첫 영어 장편 『룸 넥스트 도어』로 베니스 영화제 황금사자상을 받았다.
events.description_en: His first English-language feature, The Room Next Door, won the Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival.
